title: Two Number Ones Are Not Enough
text:
Kael and Tae fought Vaelor together.

Official #1 and unofficial co-#1.

Centre and distance.

For three minutes, they looked extraordinary.

Then Vaelor understood the partnership.

After that, he outmaneuvered both.

Kael forced commitment.

Vaelor used the commitment to create the distance Tae would need.

Tae stole the distance.

Vaelor had already assigned another authority to the transition.

Every elegant combination became something the True Crown had seen one breath earlier.

Tae attacked from behind Kael's shoulder.

Vaelor slipped between both.

One palm hit Tae's broken leg.

One elbow struck Kael's throat.

They separated violently.

Kael recovered centre.

Tae rebuilt distance.

Vaelor collapsed both.

It stopped looking like a summit duel.

It became execution delayed by stubbornness.

title: So This Is Your Summit
text:
Vaelor caught Tae first.

One hand around the throat.

Lifted him.

Then drove him into the ground hard enough to crater the plateau.

Tae's head missed the deepest point by inches because Kael forced Vaelor's wrist aside.

Vaelor rewarded him by smashing Kael across the mouth.

Kael hit stone.

Tried to rise.

Vaelor kicked him back down.

Tae attacked from one knee.

Vaelor broke the remaining stable line in his leg and threw him beside Kael.

Both Number Ones were now near death.

Kael's breathing shallow.

Tae barely conscious.

Vaelor stood over them.

[[speaker:vaelor]]“So this is your summit.”

He raised one foot above Tae's head.

Sera arrived.

Not Rhen.

Sera.

Her wire snapped around Vaelor's ankle before the stomp could fall.

The foot stopped one handspan above Tae's skull.

One second purchased.

Enough.

title: The Marquises Enter Hell
text:
Mo arrived behind Sera.

Arin.

Luo.

Yun.

#6 through #10 formed around the fallen summit.

They knew exactly what Vaelor had done to the Five Dukes.

They had seen Lei.

They fought anyway.

Mo turned the sky to paper.

Arin cut circulation handoffs.

Luo attacked damaged anatomy.

Yun contaminated breath routes.

Sera controlled every shared opening.

Vaelor broke the formation apart.

Mo was caught first.

Vaelor seized him by the throat and drove him through his own paper field into the ground.

Arin attacked.

Vaelor caught her sword arm and slammed her shoulder into stone until the joint failed.

Luo tried to reach them.

One kick folded him around broken ribs.

Yun poisoned Vaelor's hand.

He looked at the discoloration.

Then backhanded her across the plateau before the toxin could establish.

The four lower Marquises entered critical condition.

Sera remained standing.

Vaelor looked at her.

[[speaker:vaelor]]“Six.”

Sera's wire tightened.

[[speaker:sera]]“Still.”

title: The Pale Orchid Does Not Bow
text:
Vaelor attacked Sera differently.

Not gently.

But without the deliberate humiliation he had used on the others.

Sera gave him no stationary victim to punish.

Pale Orchid Beneath a Moonless Heaven fractured her position into false lines.

Vaelor struck one.

Wrong.

Second.

Wrong.

Third found her.

The impact broke ribs and reopened old meridian damage.

Sera crossed the plateau floor.

Still conscious.

Vaelor approached.

She rose to one knee.

Wire shaking in her hand.

He could have driven her face into the stone.

Could have stomped her down.

Instead he reached for her throat.

Sera buried a needle into his palm.

Vaelor stopped.

Not from pain.

From surprise.

[[speaker:sera]]“You don't get that ending.”

He struck her once across the torso.

Sera collapsed.

Gravely injured.

Alive.

Conscious enough to pull one last wire around Mo and drag him away from Vaelor's next step.

Jin's world-calamity relay activated automatically.

FIVE DUKES DOWN.

BOTH NUMBER ONES CRITICAL.

FOUR MARQUISES CRITICAL.

SERA GRAVELY INJURED.

TRUE CROWN ACTIVE.

Three provinces away, Rhen stopped moving.

title: He Comes to Her First
text:
Sera saw one frozen petal.

Then another.

Rhen appeared between her and Vaelor.

He did not look at the leader first.

He turned around.

Knelt beside Sera.

Touched her cheek.

[[speaker:rhen]]“Sera.”

She smiled faintly.

[[speaker:sera]]“Again?”

[[speaker:rhen]]“Again.”

Heaven's Return opened.

The indestructible hemisphere expanded across the fallen.

Sera.

Kael.

Tae.

Liang.

Jin.

Lei.

Rui.

Mo.

Arin.

Luo.

Ten.

Yun waited outside only until one stabilized enough to leave.

Healing began instantly.

Bones.

Organs.

Meridians.

Qi.

Vaelor struck the hemisphere.

Nothing happened.

title: Put Him Down
text:
Vaelor hit Heaven's Return again.

Full True Crown.

The hemisphere did not move.

Rhen stepped outside.

The barrier sealed behind him.

Vaelor had grabbed Tae again after Tae rolled beyond the hemisphere's first expansion edge.

Rhen looked at him.

[[speaker:rhen]]“Put him down.”

Vaelor turned.

[[speaker:vaelor]]“You must be Rhen.”

[[speaker:rhen]]“Apparently.”

Vaelor tightened his grip.

Tae's face darkened.

Rhen's expression changed.

No visible anger.

Something colder.

Sera saw it from inside the barrier.

She had seen that face once before.

Draven had died shortly afterward.

title: Winter Has No Horizon
text:
Vaelor threw Tae aside and activated all seven authorities.

Rhen stood fifty metres away.

No sword.

No stance.

He raised one hand.

**TRANSCENDED SKILL — WINTER HAS NO HORIZON.**

There was no visible movement.

No teleportation.

No spatial tear.

Rhen's intent, movement, qi transmission and impact became one event.

All seven circulation authorities stopped simultaneously.

Then the sound arrived.

Seven impacts.

One after another.

Vaelor dropped to one knee.

The battlefield went silent.

Rhen looked at him.

[[speaker:rhen]]“Stay down.”

title: Beyond the Summit
text:
Vaelor stood.

That alone earned recognition.

The True Crown restarted.

One authority.

Two.

All seven.

He attacked with everything that had defeated the Five Dukes and both Number Ones.

Rhen stepped once.

His palm touched Vaelor's chest.

No explosion at contact.

One second passed.

Then the ground behind Vaelor collapsed for miles.

The Crown Beyond Crowns remained upright.

One second.

Then fell.

No Supreme Art.

No Ultimate.

One Transcended Skill.

One unnamed palm.

The strongest foreign sovereign the East had faced was finished.

Pre-seclusion Rhen could have defeated him.

Post-seclusion Rhen made the comparison meaningless.

title: Petals in Stasis
text:
After the battle, Sera found the sealed page in Rhen's notes.

**SUPREME ART — PETALS IN STASIS.**

Still unrevealed.

Still unused.

One or many targets could be enclosed inside a sealed domain where causal progression ceased relative to the outside world.

No movement.

No thought.

No pain.

No hunger.

No qi circulation.

No subjective passage of time.

When released, the targets would experience nothing between capture and return.

Sera read the page twice.

[[speaker:sera]]“And this is below the Ultimate?”

Rhen nodded.

[[speaker:sera]]“How?”

Rhen looked at one frozen petal.

[[speaker:rhen]]“Stasis stops progression.”

He paused.

[[speaker:rhen]]“The Ultimate decides the ending.”

Sera closed the notebook.

title: Tea After the End of the World
text:
The surviving Crowns lowered their heads.

Vaelor lived under treaty custody.

The Five Dukes recovered inside Heaven's Return.

Both Number Ones lived.

The Marquises stood back up.

The ranking board did not change.

The world did.

That night, after the last emergency treatment ended, Rhen found a kettle in the summit infirmary.

He made tea badly.

Sera drank it anyway.

No army was advancing.

No Duke was dying in front of them.

No foreign sovereign was still threatening civilization.

For the first time since Vaelor arrived, the room was quiet enough for Sera to simply watch him.

[[speaker:sera]]“Come here.”

Rhen did.

She wrapped her arms around his waist.

[[speaker:rhen]]“Everything okay?”

[[speaker:sera]]“Yes.”

Pause.

[[speaker:sera]]“That's why.”

He held her.

Outside, one frozen petal drifted past the window.

Moving normally.

For once, that was enough.
